description: Look up a domain's registration from the registry's RDAP record: registered, last changed and expiry dates, age in days, the registrar, status codes (transfer lock) and the registrant's country when published — never a person's name, address or email. Checks warn on a very new domain, a near expiry and a missing lock. No visit to the site. at most 20 checks an hour per network and 30 an hour per site checked.

domain.description: The domain to look up (example.com), or any URL on it.

name: lookup_domain

checks.description: Fails first. `fix` is the one action to take; null on a pass.

facts.description: What was read, as labelled rows. From the site or a registry: unverified.

listing.description: Whether the site is listed on the directory: its page when it is, where to list it when not.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a page on the site.

title: Look up a domain's registration
